request: In the fish suggestion generator, emit disabling switches as bare words without the long-option marker, so our downstream formatter can add that prefix itself.

source.request: In the fish suggestion generator, emit disabling switches as bare words without the long-option marker, so our downstream formatter can add that prefix itself.
source.settled: Generated fish completions mark negation options with -l and do not offer argument choices for those options.
source.why: Omitting the long-option marker restores the invalid completion syntax that the ticket fixed.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
